claim: Resolver DNS Firewall filters and regulates outbound DNS traffic for your VPC. You create rule groups of filtering rules, associate them with your VPC, and monitor activity in DNS Firewall logs and metrics.

reusable collections of filtering rules in DNS Firewall rule groups

evidence.quote: With Resolver DNS Firewall, you can filter and regulate outbound DNS traffic for your virtual private cloud (VPC). claim: A primary use of DNS Firewall protections is to help prevent DNS exfiltration of your data. You can deny the domains you know to be bad, or deny all domains except the ones you explicitly trust.

values.display: help prevent DNS exfiltration of your data
deny access to all domains except for the ones that you explicitly trust

evidence.quote: A primary use of DNS Firewall protections is to help prevent DNS exfiltration of your data.
You can deny access to the domains that you know to be bad and allow all other queries to pass through. Alternately, you can deny access to all domains except for the ones that you explicitly trust.
